_comment: Tier-2 for NGSolve heat#3: non-homogeneous Dirichlet needs the two-step pattern -- gfu.Set(bc, definedon=...) then gfu.vec.data += a.mat.Inverse(fes.FreeDofs()) * (f.vec - a.mat*gfu.vec). Measured on 6.2.2604 with the harmonic u = x^2 - y^2 on unit_square maxh=0.3, H1(order=2), which the space represents exactly: the two-step pattern gives an L2 error at machine zero, while the one-step assignment gfu.vec.data = Inverse*f.vec silently discards the Set boundary values and gives an O(1) error with no exception.
